question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a pink ball, Dave has a red ball, and Eve has a white ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) silver ball
(C) pink ball
(D) red ball
(E) white ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: brown, silver, pink, red, white
1. Dave–Claire: brown, silver, red, pink, white
2. Claire–Eve: brown, silver, white, pink, red
3. Claire–Eve: brown, silver, red, pink, white
4. Eve–Dave: brown, silver, red, white, pink
5. Claire–Alice: red, silver, brown, white, pink
Eve has the pink ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
